title: 餐饮业都在喊难：星巴克客流居然逆势增长，数据方称近乎绝缘

segments.en: Especially the time there's a lot of pressure for the restaurant industry and you know the category as a whole It has got a lot more challenging particularly starting to see gas prices back around 450 per gallon
segments.zh: 尤其是餐饮行业面临很大压力的时候，整个品类变得更具挑战性，特别是汽油价格回到每加仑4.50美元左右

segments.en: A lot more competitors in the space But I think the interesting thing with our data too is that Starbucks sees be someone insulated They're continuing to put up fairly good numbers and you know
segments.zh: 这个领域竞争对手多得多。但我认为我们数据中有趣的是，星巴克似乎有些绝缘，他们继续交出相当不错的数字
